// Solve parses an alphametics puzzle of the form "WORD + WORD == WORD" and
// returns a map of letter to digit substitutions that make the sum valid.
func Solve(puzzle string) (map[string]int, error) {
        parts := strings.Split(puzzle, "==")
        if len(parts) != 2 {
                return nil, errors.New("puzzle must contain exactly one == 
operator")
        }

        var words []string
        for _, field := range strings.Fields(parts[0]) {
                if field == "+" {
                        continue
                }
                if !isWord(field) {
                        return nil, errors.New("invalid term in puzzle")
                }
                words = append(words, field)
        }
        if len(words) == 0 {
                return nil, errors.New("puzzle must contain at least one 
addend")
        }

        right := strings.Fields(parts[1])
        if len(right) != 1 || !isWord(right[0]) {
                return nil, errors.New("invalid result in puzzle")
        }
        result := right[0]

        maxAddendLen := 0
        for _, w := range words {
                if len(w) > maxAddendLen {
                        maxAddendLen = len(w)
                }
        }
        // The sum of the addends always has at least as many digits as the
        // longest addend, so a shorter result can never be reached.
        if len(result) < maxAddendLen {
                return nil, errors.New("no solution")
        }

        // Collect the unique letters in order of column significance (rightmost
        // column first) so that column sums can be checked as early as 
possible.
        index := make(map[byte]int)
        var letters []byte
        addendCols := make([][]int, len(result))
        resultCol := make([]int, len(result))

        for col := 0; col < len(result); col++ {
                for _, w := range words {
                        if len(w) <= col {
                                continue
                        }
                        addendCols[col] = append(addendCols[col], 
letterIdx(index, &letters, w[len(w)-1-col]))
                }
                resultCol[col] = letterIdx(index, &letters, 
result[len(result)-1-col])
        }

        if len(letters) > 10 {
                return nil, errors.New("no solution")
        }

        // Letters that begin a multi-digit word must not be assigned zero.
        mustBeNonZero := make([]bool, len(letters))
        for _, w := range words {
                if len(w) > 1 {
                        mustBeNonZero[index[w[0]]] = true
                }
        }
        if len(result) > 1 {
                mustBeNonZero[index[result[0]]] = true
        }

        values := make([]int, len(letters))
        assigned := make([]bool, len(letters))
        used := make([]bool, 10)

        var solveColumn func(col, carry int) bool

        // assign assigns digits to the unassigned letters of the current 
column.
        var assign func(col, carry int, pending []int) bool
        assign = func(col, carry int, pending []int) bool {
                if len(pending) == 0 {
                        sum := carry
                        for _, idx := range addendCols[col] {
                                sum += values[idx]
                        }
                        if sum%10 != values[resultCol[col]] {
                                return false
                        }
                        return solveColumn(col+1, sum/10)
                }
                idx := pending[0]
                rest := pending[1:]
                for digit := 0; digit <= 9; digit++ {
                        if used[digit] || (digit == 0 && mustBeNonZero[idx]) {
                                continue
                        }
                        used[digit] = true
                        assigned[idx] = true
                        values[idx] = digit
                        if assign(col, carry, rest) {
                                return true
                        }
                        used[digit] = false
                        assigned[idx] = false
                }
                return false
        }

        solveColumn = func(col, carry int) bool {
                if col == len(result) {
                        return carry == 0
                }
                var pending []int
                seen := make([]bool, len(letters))
                for _, idx := range addendCols[col] {
                        if !assigned[idx] && !seen[idx] {
                                seen[idx] = true
                                pending = append(pending, idx)
                        }
                }
                if !assigned[resultCol[col]] && !seen[resultCol[col]] {
                        pending = append(pending, resultCol[col])
                }
                return assign(col, carry, pending)
        }

        if !solveColumn(0, 0) {
                return nil, errors.New("no solution")
        }

        solution := make(map[string]int, len(letters))
        for i, l := range letters {
                solution[string(l)] = values[i]
        }
        return solution, nil
}

func letterIdx(index map[byte]int, letters *[]byte, letter byte) int {
        if idx, ok := index[letter]; ok {
                return idx
        }
        idx := len(*letters)
        index[letter] = idx
        *letters = append(*letters, letter)
        return idx
}

func isWord(s string) bool {
        if s == "" {
                return false
        }
        for _, r := range s {
                if r < 'A' || r > 'Z' {
                        return false
                }
        }
        return true
}
